claims.text: The CASA track explores an agent substrate based on cellular automata (CA) instead of the dominant matrix-heavy stack.
claims.section: CASA-ADR-0001: CA substrate agent track / Context

claims.text: CA are Turing-complete, so feasibility in principle is not the blocker.
claims.section: CASA-ADR-0001: CA substrate agent track / Context

claims.text: The practical challenge is engineering: stability, controllability, robustness, observability, and cost.
claims.section: CASA-ADR-0001: CA substrate agent track / Context

claims.text: equation-to-ca-cuda (ETCC) exists as a separate engineering line for PDE/CA/CUDA validation and must not absorb CASA goals.
claims.section: CASA-ADR-0001: CA substrate agent track / Context

claims.text: Core question: not "can it work?", but "how to make it work reliably under real constraints?"
